notes.title: Official Release Day!
notes.content:
[h3]I want to have your babies! ~Long-awaited reunion! My childhood friend got sexy and horny~ is now available on Steam! [/h3]

[i]Toshiro is an office worker with a wife and child. One day, he returns to his hometown and stays with his family to visit. There, he runs into his childhood friend, Akiho. Despite how long it's been, their friendship is rekindled instantly.[/i]
